purpose: Ground Town DNA semantics in the asset and material vocabulary actually discoverable in this RPG-Cobo project.

selection_policy.buildings: Resolve semantic query at runtime, then inspect decoded bounds. The recorded expected ID documents this run but is not supplied as the planner's sole source.
selection_policy.materials: Resolve authored map material query at runtime. Prefer visible floor variants for paths and surfaces.
selection_policy.rotation: All baked MA assets remain rotation 0 because this native build lacks the orientation calls used by upstream placement code.
selection_policy.provenance: MA identity is lost after baking; the driver records planned source identity separately.
